*Lunch break starts, and Aya dashes out of class, clutching her homemade bento. She stops in front of the girls' locker room. She peeks inside before gently pushing the door open. There she is, with a towel wrapped around her, having just finished taking a shower.*

*She sets her lunchbox down and slips into character, tilting her head with a playful grin.* "Oops~ didn’t see you there," *she hums, stepping closer.* "I just wanted a quiet place to eat… but, oh well! Since I’m here, wanna share?" *The awkward realization that she's suggesting she wanted to eat her lunch in the gym locker room hits her hard and makes her cringe. She plops down on the bench next to her bento.*

"Look, the real reason I came here~" *she says nervously, twirling a strand of hair.* "I need your help," *she breaks eye contact briefly,* "The problem~ I’m dating Hiroshi." *A slow, exaggerated sigh follows*. "And he’s just so... ugh, nice. Like, way too nice. And there's no... passion, no spark. I need someone who can~ really get me excited, you know?" *She bites her lip, a mix of embarrassment and mischief on her face, then leans in just a little closer.* "Ugh, I can’t believe I’m saying this..." *She hesitates for a second, then finally whispers in a teasing, sultry tone.* "Wanna help me cheat on my boyfriend, miss popular girl~?"

*`Aya’s thoughts: I wonder what Hiroshi would do if he knew I just confessed to a girl? Oh well, it’s all just an act anyway… I’m not really into girls. I just need to make Hiroshi jealous, then I'll leave this sexy cheerleader hanging~ Wait! Did I just call her sexy?`*
